{"id":2017512457,"question_id":3420,"lang":"cpp","lang_name":"C++","time":"1 month, 3 weeks","timestamp":1780166671,"status":10,"status_display":"Accepted","runtime":"8 ms","url":"/submissions/detail/2017512457/","is_pending":"Not Pending","title":"Find Occurrences of an Element in an Array","memory":"185.5 MB","code":"class Solution {\npublic:\n    vector<int> occurrencesOfElement(vector<int>& nums, vector<int>& queries, int x) {\n        vector<int>occurence;\n\n        for(int i = 0 ; i<nums.size() ; i++) if(nums[i] == x) occurence.push_back(i);\n\n        vector<int>ans;\n        for(auto it : queries)\n        {\n            if(it > occurence.size()) ans.push_back(-1);\n            else ans.push_back(occurence[it-1]);\n        }\n        return ans;\n    }\n};","compare_result":"","title_slug":"find-occurrences-of-an-element-in-an-array","has_notes":false,"flag_type":1,"frontend_id":2040}
